gold_facts.text: Except where the law provides otherwise, movable things can be pledged only by transferring possession to the creditor.
No pledge right exists as long as the pledgor retains exclusive actual control of the thing.

competing_candidates: The statutory exception for pledging livestock without transfer of possession is a different rule; a motorbike does not fall under it.
provenance.critic_notes: 'Das Pfandrecht ist nicht begründet, solange der Verpfänder die ausschliessliche Gewalt ... behält.' Facts match Abs 1 and 3. 210:717 (constitutum possessorium) and 210:885 (livestock) are related but do not give the pledge answer. No lexical signal.

question: I lent a friend money and he offered his motorbike as security, but he wants to keep riding it himself until he pays me back. Can I get a valid security right over the bike while it stays with him?

gold_facts.text: To secure its claims for contributions of the last three years, the community of owners is entitled to have a legal mortgage established on the share of each co-owner.

Registration can be requested by the administrator or, if there is none, by any co-owner authorised by a majority decision of the co-owners or by the court, and by a creditor in whose favour the contribution claim was seized.
Otherwise the rules on establishing the legal mortgage of craftsmen and contractors apply by analogy.

competing_candidates: The community's retention right over movables in the unit secures the same contributions; the question is narrowed to a security on the unit share itself.
provenance.critic_notes: 'Beitragsforderungen ... letzten drei Jahre ... Errichtung eines Pfandrechtes an dessen Anteil' (de); applicants in Abs 2 match fact 2 in 3 langs. Retention right 210:712k excluded by 'sur son lot'. fr 18.

question: Dans notre immeuble en propriété par étages, un propriétaire ne paie plus ses charges communes depuis plusieurs années. La communauté peut-elle obtenir une garantie inscrite directement sur son lot, pour quels arriérés, et qui peut demander cette inscription ?

gold_facts.text: A person who suffers or is threatened with harm because a landowner exceeds his property right can sue the owner to restore the previous state or to take measures against the danger, in addition to damages.
If a building or installation deprives the neighbouring property of certain qualities, the owner can be sued only if the building rules in force when it was built were not respected.

competing_candidates: The rule defining excessive emissions between neighbours describes the duty but not this limitation for buildings; planting distance or excavation rules are different topics.
provenance.critic_notes: Abs 2: 'nur, wenn ... die damals geltenden Vorschriften nicht eingehalten wurden'. 210:684 names 'Entzug von Besonnung oder Tageslicht' and will rank high, but only 679 Abs 2 gives the building-rules limit. it 36.

question: Il mio vicino ha costruito anni fa un edificio alto che toglie luce e sole alla mia casa. A suo tempo ha rispettato tutte le norme edilizie in vigore. Posso comunque fargli causa per questa perdita, e in quali casi invece potrei agire?

gold_facts.text: The land registrar must notify interested persons of entries made without their knowledge.
In particular, the registrar notifies the acquisition of ownership by a third party to the holders of a pre-emption right that is noted in the land register or given by law and shown in the register.
The time limits for contesting such entries start to run from the notification.

competing_candidates: The seller's own duty to inform the pre-emption holder and the time limit for exercising the pre-emption right (in the Code of Obligations and in the Civil Code rules on statutory pre-emption) concern the same sale; the question is narrowed to the registrar's duty and the time limit for contesting the entry.
provenance.critic_notes: 'teilt er den Berechtigten, deren Vorkaufsrecht im Grundbuch vorgemerkt ist ... mit'; Abs 2 time limits from notice. 'im Grundbuch vorgemerktes Vorkaufsrecht' echoes the text but de rank 16 only. Seller duty 220:216d/216e concerns exercise, not the registrar.

question: Ich habe ein im Grundbuch vorgemerktes Vorkaufsrecht am Nachbargrundstück. Der Eigentümer verkauft es nun an jemand anderen, ohne mir etwas zu sagen. Muss mich das Grundbuchamt von sich aus darüber informieren, und ab wann läuft für mich die Frist, um die Eintragung anzufechten?

gold_facts.text: Buildings and other structures projecting from one property over another remain part of the property they project from if their owner has a real right to their existence; this right can be registered as an easement.

If the projecting structure was built without a right but the injured neighbour did not object in time although it was recognisable, the court may, where the circumstances justify it, grant the builder acting in good faith the real right to the structure or ownership of the land.
Such a grant by the court is made against fair compensation.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring rules on building on another person's land with one's own materials (allocation of land ownership) are similar but concern construction on, not projecting over, the land.
provenance.critic_notes: Abs 3: 'dem Überbauenden, der sich in gutem Glauben befindet, gegen angemessene Entschädigung'. Facts 2-3 fit the scenario; fact 1 is background but supported. 210:673 (building on land of another) is a different case. No lexical signal.

question: Years ago my neighbour built a balcony that hangs over our garden, without any agreement with us. We saw it being built and never complained. Now we want it gone. Could a court instead let him keep it, and on what terms?

gold_facts.text: When it orders a measure, the adult protection authority immediately notifies the debt enforcement office at the person's domicile, once the decision is enforceable, of any placement of a minor under guardianship or under the curatorship for the administration of the child's property.
If there is no other way to prevent the child's property from being endangered, the child protection authority entrusts its administration to a curator.
The child protection authority can also entrust administration to a curator if it is feared that the income of the child's property or amounts taken from it will not be used as the law requires.

competing_candidates: General rules on child protection measures and on the parents' use of the child's property are neighbours of B but do not provide the curator for administration.
provenance.critic_notes: 449c Ziff 3a: 'dem Betreibungsamt ... Beistandschaft nach Artikel 325'; 325 Abs 1 gives the condition. Second article needed. 449c names the adult protection authority, which also acts as child protection authority (210:440). de 8, 'Betreibungsamt' reused but natural.

question: Die Behörde hat für das Vermögen meines minderjährigen Neffen einen Beistand eingesetzt, weil seine Eltern das Geld des Kindes zu verschleudern drohten. Wird darüber das Betreibungsamt informiert, und unter welchen Voraussetzungen setzt die Behörde überhaupt einen solchen Verwalter für das Kindesvermögen ein?

gold_facts.text: The consent of the adult protection authority is required when the curator, acting as the person's representative, sells or pledges land.
The consent of the adult protection authority is also required when the curator terminates the contract for premises in which the person lives or liquidates the household.
Consent is not required if the person, being capable of judgement, agrees and her capacity to act is not restricted by the curatorship.

competing_candidates: The rule allowing the authority to make further transactions subject to its consent for specific reasons is a neighbour but does not list these acts.
provenance.critic_notes: Ziff 1 and 4: 'Kündigung des Vertrags über Räumlichkeiten', 'Veräusserung ... von Grundstücken'; Abs 2 exception supported. Dementia makes the exception moot but fact is accurate. fr 22. 210:417 does not list these acts.

question: Ma mère, atteinte de démence, est sous curatelle. Son curateur veut vendre sa maison et mettre fin au bail de l'appartement où elle vit. Peut-il le faire de sa propre initiative, ou doit-il obtenir une autorisation, et de qui ?

gold_facts.text: If a mortgage was created in a later rank without a prior one existing, or the debtor has not disposed of a prior mortgage certificate, or the prior claim is smaller than registered, the empty ranks are disregarded in the realisation.
In the realisation of the pledge the proceeds are allocated to the actual mortgage creditors according to their rank.

competing_candidates: The rule on fixed ranks and empty pledge positions (no automatic advancement of later creditors) concerns ranking outside realisation and could be retrieved instead; the question is narrowed to the forced sale.
provenance.critic_notes: 'ohne Rücksicht auf die leeren Pfandstellen den wirklichen Pfandgläubigern nach ihrem Range' (de). Facts supported in 3 langs. 210:813/814 (fixed rank, no advancement) are close but concern ranking, not realisation. it 13.

question: Sulla mia casa c'è un'ipoteca registrata al secondo posto, ma al primo posto non c'è nessun debito reale: non è mai stata costituita alcuna ipoteca prima. Se la casa viene venduta all'asta, come si divide il ricavato tra i creditori? Il posto vuoto viene tenuto da parte?

gold_facts.text: If one of the engaged persons made arrangements in good faith with a view to the marriage, they can claim an appropriate contribution from the other when the engagement is dissolved.
The claim exists only where it does not appear inequitable in view of all the circumstances.

competing_candidates: Neighbouring rules on returning engagement gifts and on the time limit for engagement claims cover related topics but not the cost contribution.
provenance.critic_notes: 'kann sie oder er bei Auflösung des Verlöbnisses ... einen angemessenen Beitrag verlangen' (de); inequity proviso in all langs. 210:91 (gifts) does not compete. No lexical signal.

question: My fiancée and I called off our engagement. I had already paid deposits for the wedding venue and the caterer. Can I ask her to share those costs?

gold_facts.text: A legal act done without the required consent of the adult protection authority has, for the person concerned, only the effects that the law of persons provides when the consent of the legal representative is missing.

competing_candidates: The law-of-persons rules on acts done without the legal representative's consent (restitution, liability) give the detailed effects to which A refers.
provenance.critic_notes: fr: 'que les effets prévus par le droit des personnes en cas de défaut du consentement'. Single fact supported. Weakness: the second sub-question hands over the comparison, and the first (Quelles conséquences) invites the detail of 210:19b, which gold does not include. Acceptable as easy control item.
provenance.writer_note: Same-language control item; question avoids the article's terms where possible.

question: Le curateur de mon oncle a signé pour lui un contrat important sans demander l'accord de l'autorité qui le surveille, alors que cet accord était obligatoire. Quelles conséquences ce contrat a-t-il pour mon oncle : est-il traité autrement que si une personne protégée avait signé elle-même sans l'accord de son représentant ?

gold_facts.text: The provisions on ordinary leases apply by analogy if the lessor fails to hand over the thing on the agreed date or hands it over with defects.
They also apply by analogy if defects arise that are not attributable to the lessee and that he is not obliged to remedy at his own expense.
Deviations to the lessee's detriment are void if contained in pre-printed general terms or in leases of residential or commercial premises.

competing_candidates: The ordinary lease rules on the tenant's rights in case of defects and late delivery, which state the actual remedies; A is the provision that makes them applicable to this kind of lease and limits deviations.
provenance.critic_notes: Shortening keeps all conditions: usufructuary lease (not ordinary rental), late handover, defect not lessee's fault or duty, pre-printed clause (288 al.1 a-b, al.2 a). Natural EN; no ranks.

question: I run a restaurant under a lease where I keep the earnings (not a plain room rental). The owner handed it over months late, and the kitchen ventilation is broken through no fault of mine and not mine to repair. Which rules govern my claims, and is the pre-printed contract clause excluding any claim valid?

gold_facts.text: Members who leave the company remain subject to the obligation to make additional contributions for three years.
The time of leaving is determined by the entry in the commercial register.
Former members have to make additional contributions only if the company goes bankrupt.

competing_candidates: The cooperative rules on the continuing liability of members who have left; the question is about a limited liability company.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported (de): 'besteht die Nachschusspflicht ... während dreier Jahre weiter'; 'nach der Eintragung ins Handelsregister'; 'nur, wenn die Gesellschaft in Konkurs fällt'. GmbH stated, which separates it from the cooperative rule 220:876. DE rank 1: 'Zeitpunkt ... Ausscheiden' echoes Abs. 1, but the term Nachschuss is not used. Borderline overlap.

question: Ich bin vor gut einem Jahr aus einer GmbH ausgeschieden, deren Statuten vorsehen, dass die Gesellschafter bei Bedarf zusätzliches Geld einschiessen müssen. Die Firma läuft weiter, hat aber Geldprobleme und verlangt jetzt auch von mir eine Zahlung. Muss ich als Ehemaliger noch zahlen, und ab welchem Zeitpunkt gilt mein Ausscheiden überhaupt?

gold_facts.text: General meeting resolutions are void if they abolish or limit the shareholders' right to bring an action or other shareholder rights guaranteed by mandatory law.
Resolutions are void if they restrict the shareholders' control rights beyond what the law permits.

competing_candidates: The stock-company rule on challenging general meeting resolutions that breach the law or the articles, which covers voidable rather than void resolutions.
provenance.critic_notes: Now restricts control rights below the legal level, so fact 2 triggers. it: 'limitano i diritti di controllo degli azionisti oltre la misura ammessa'. 'nulle di per sé' separates 706b from 706. it 2, generic term.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: the resolution now clearly restricts information and inspection rights below the legal level.

question: Nella nostra società anonima la maggioranza ha fatto approvare in assemblea che i piccoli azionisti non potranno più fare causa alla società né chiedere informazioni o consultare i documenti sociali, nemmeno nei casi in cui la legge lo consente. Mi hanno detto che alcune decisioni dell'assemblea sono nulle di per sé. Questa è una di quelle?

gold_facts.text: Unless otherwise agreed or provided by local custom, the lessee must pay the rent and any ancillary costs at the end of each lease year, at the latest when the lease ends.
For ancillary costs, the corresponding rule of ordinary lease law applies.
Ancillary costs are payment for services provided by the landlord or a third party in connection with the use of the thing.
The tenant has to bear ancillary costs only if this has been specifically agreed.

provenance.critic_notes: Supported (de): 281 'am Ende eines Pachtjahres, spätestens aber am Ende der Pachtzeit'; 'Für die Nebenkosten gilt Artikel 257a'; 257a 'nur bezahlen, wenn er dies ... besonders vereinbart hat'. Cross-ref is genuine. DE rank 3, from Pachtzins/Pächter, which are unavoidable.

question: Ich habe eine Gärtnerei gepachtet. Der Verpächter verlangt neben dem Pachtzins plötzlich jeden Monat Geld für Wasser und Heizung, obwohl im Vertrag dazu gar nichts steht, und er will auch den Pachtzins selbst monatlich. Im Vertrag ist kein Zahlungstermin geregelt, und bei uns gibt es keinen besonderen Ortsgebrauch. Wann muss ich zahlen, und muss ich diese Zusatzkosten übernehmen?

gold_facts.text: The protection against termination applies to subleases as long as the main lease has not ended, and a sublease can only be extended for the duration of the main lease.
If the sublease is mainly intended to circumvent the protection against termination, the subtenant is protected regardless of the main lease.
In that case, if the main lease is terminated, the landlord takes the tenant's place in the contract with the subtenant.

competing_candidates: The general lease rule on subletting with the landlord's consent, which does not address protection against termination.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported (fr): 'La prolongation n'est possible que pour la durée du bail principal'; 'le sous-locataire bénéficie de cette protection sans égard au bail principal'; 'le bailleur principal est subrogé'. FR rank 1 from the title term 'sous-location', which is the natural word; the scenario is paraphrased.

question: Je sous-loue un appartement à la locataire principale. Le propriétaire vient de résilier son bail à elle. Est-ce que je peux obtenir de rester plus longtemps que la fin de son bail à elle? Et qu'en est-il si cette sous-location avait surtout été montée pour priver l'occupant de la protection habituelle des locataires?

gold_facts.text: Professional marriage or partnership brokerage involving persons abroad requires authorisation and is supervised by an authority designated by cantonal law.
The Federal Council issues the implementing provisions, including the conditions and duration of the authorisation.

provenance.critic_notes: Sanctions fact removed. de: 'bedarf der Bewilligung einer vom kantonalen Recht bezeichneten Stelle und untersteht deren Aufsicht'; 'Bundesrat erlässt die Ausführungsvorschriften'. EN; ranks above 300.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: fact on sanctions and return-travel guarantee removed.

question: I'd like to start a business that, for a fee, introduces people in Switzerland to possible wives or husbands living abroad. Do I need some kind of official permission for this, who grants it and keeps an eye on such businesses, and where are the detailed conditions laid down?

gold_facts.text: If the principal debtor is six months in arrears with capital, half a year's interest or an annual amortisation payment, the creditor must notify the surety.
In the principal debtor's bankruptcy, the creditor must file its claim and notify the surety of the bankruptcy as soon as it learns of it.
If the creditor fails to do so, it loses its claims against the surety to the extent the surety suffered damage from the omission.

competing_candidates: The surety rule on the creditor's liability for reducing other securities, which concerns a different kind of creditor misconduct.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported (de): 'sechs Monate im Rückstand, so hat der Gläubiger dem Bürgen Mitteilung zu machen'; 'verliert er seine Ansprüche ... insoweit, als diesem ... ein Schaden entstanden ist'. DE control, rank 2; shared words (Konkurs, Forderung, Schaden) are generic.

question: Ich habe für den Kredit meines Bruders bei seiner Bank gebürgt. Er hat seit über einem halben Jahr keine Raten mehr bezahlt, aber die Bank hat mir nie etwas davon gesagt. Jetzt ist er in Konkurs gegangen, und die Bank hat ihre Forderung dort nicht einmal eingegeben, wodurch mir ein Schaden entstanden ist. Kann sie trotzdem den vollen Betrag von mir verlangen?

gold_facts.text: The commission agent may claim reimbursement of all advances, expenses and other outlays made in the principal's interest, and may charge interest on them.
He may also charge for the use of storage space and means of transport.
He may not charge the wages of his employees.

competing_candidates: The mandate rule on the principal's duty to reimburse the agent's expenses with interest, which applies to mandates generally but does not address storage, transport or staff wages.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported (it): 'diritto alla rifusione, coi relativi interessi'; 'compenso anche per l'uso dei magazzini e dei mezzi di trasporto, ma non pel salario'. Commission is clearly described. 220:402 (mandate expenses) only partly overlaps; the wage exclusion exists only in 431. IT rank 13.

question: Ho affidato a un commerciante la vendita di una partita del mio vino: lui la vende a nome suo ma per conto mio, in cambio di una provvigione. Ora mi chiede di rimborsargli le spese che ha anticipato, con gli interessi, più l'affitto del suo magazzino, il trasporto e una parte dello stipendio dei suoi impiegati. Cosa posso rifiutare di pagare?

gold_facts.text: Where a specified quantity of fungible goods is sold, the buyer may choose between rescission, price reduction, or delivery of other acceptable goods of the same kind.

Unless the goods were shipped from another place, the seller can free himself from any further claims by immediately delivering acceptable goods of the same kind and compensating the buyer for all damage.

competing_candidates: The general sales rule giving the buyer the choice between rescission and price reduction for defects, which does not provide for replacement.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported (fr): 'l'acheteur a le choix ... d'exiger d'autres choses recevables du même genre'; 's'il ne s'agit pas de choses expédiées d'un autre lieu, se libérer'. A local wine shop meets the not-shipped condition. FR control, rank 51.

question: J'ai acheté deux cents bouteilles d'un vin précis chez un caviste de ma ville, et une bonne partie a un goût de bouchon. Plutôt que de simplement payer moins, est-ce que je peux exiger qu'il me donne d'autres bouteilles du même vin en bon état? Et lui, peut-il clore l'affaire en m'échangeant tout de suite les bouteilles?

gold_facts.text: The articles may authorise the general meeting or the administration to delegate management and representation to one or more managers, directors or other persons, who need not be members.
The cooperative must be able to be represented by a person domiciled in Switzerland who is a member of the administration, a manager or a director, and who has access to the register of members.
The cooperative keeps a register listing the name and surname or business name and the address of each member.
The register must be kept so that it can be accessed at any time in Switzerland.

provenance.critic_notes: Supported (fr): 898 'n'ont pas nécessairement la qualité d'associés'; 'représentée par une personne domiciliée en Suisse'; 'accès à la liste des associés selon l'art. 837'; 837 names, address, 'accéder en tout temps en Suisse'. Cooperative is stated, which separates it from the AG/GmbH twins (718/686, 814/790). FR rank 2.

question: Notre coopérative d'habitation aimerait confier la conduite des affaires et la représentation à un directeur externe, qui n'est pas membre. Tous nos administrateurs habitent en France. Est-ce permis, qui doit pouvoir représenter la coopérative depuis la Suisse, et à quel registre des membres cette personne doit-elle avoir accès, avec quelles informations dedans?

gold_facts.text: From the start of the limitation period, the debtor may waive the limitation defence for at most ten years at a time.
The waiver must be made in writing.
A waiver by the principal debtor cannot be invoked against the surety.

provenance.critic_notes: Supported (de): 'jeweils für höchstens zehn Jahre'; 'Der Verzicht muss in schriftlicher Form erfolgen'; 'für den Bürgen beim Verzicht des Hauptschuldners'. EN, natural wording; ranks above 700 or null.

question: A builder owes me money for botched work and asked me not to take him to court yet. He offered to promise that he won't later argue that I waited too long to claim. How long can such a promise be valid, does it have to be in writing, and can I rely on it against the person who stood surety for his debt?

gold_facts.text: A lease may be concluded for a fixed or an indefinite term.
A lease is for a fixed term if it is to end without notice at the agreed expiry date.
All other leases are considered to be of indefinite duration.

competing_candidates: The lease rule on the expiry of fixed-term leases, which says such leases end without notice and become indefinite if tacitly continued; it presupposes the distinction rather than defining it.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported (de): 'Befristet ist das Mietverhältnis, wenn es ohne Kündigung ... endigen soll'; 'Die übrigen ... gelten als unbefristet'. DE rank 1 comes from the concept words befristet/unbefristet, which a layperson would also use; a rewrite would make 220:266 compete. Kept, with an overlap flag.

question: In meinem Wohnungsmietvertrag steht eine Mindestdauer von zwei Jahren; danach soll er mit drei Monaten Frist kündbar sein. Gilt so ein Vertrag rechtlich als befristet oder als unbefristet, und woran erkennt man den Unterschied?

gold_facts.text: The commercial register is a set of state-run databases.
Its purpose is in particular to record and publish legally relevant facts about legal entities, ensuring legal certainty and the protection of third parties.
Legal entities in this sense include, among others, associations, foundations and branches.

competing_candidates: The commercial-register rule on the public nature and effect of entries.
The Civil Code rule on when an association must register in the commercial register (the question asks about the register's scope and purpose, not the duty to register).
provenance.critic_notes: 'Chi lo tiene' removed, 220:928 no longer competes. it: 'insieme di banche dati tenute dallo Stato'; list has associazioni, fondazioni, succursali. Same-lang control, it 4. 210:61 duty to register is tangential.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: 'who keeps it' removed, since the rule on cantonal register offices answers that more precisely.

question: Vorrei capire che cos'è il registro di commercio e perché è utile a chi fa affari con un'azienda. E vi rientrano solo le società, o anche associazioni, fondazioni e succursali?

gold_facts.text: The agent is generally liable for the same degree of care as an employee in an employment relationship.
The agent is liable to the principal for the faithful and careful performance of the business entrusted to him.
The agent must perform the business personally unless authorised to delegate it, compelled by circumstances, or where substitution is customarily allowed.

competing_candidates: The mandate rule on the agent's liability for a substitute, which concerns the consequences of delegation rather than whether it is allowed.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported (fr): 'aux mêmes règles que celle du travailleur'; 'responsable ... de la bonne et fidèle exécution'; 'tenu de l'exécuter personnellement, à moins qu'il ne soit autorisé'. 220:399 (liability for unauthorised substitution) is adjacent but not asked. FR rank 1373.

question: J'ai chargé une avocate de négocier pour moi un arrangement avec mon ancien associé. Sans me demander, elle a confié tout le dossier à un confrère d'un autre cabinet. Rien dans notre accord ne l'y autorisait, et rien ne l'y obligeait. En avait-elle le droit, et quel niveau de soin doit-elle m'apporter?

gold_facts.text: Companies must set up a management system defining their supply-chain policy for minerals and metals potentially from conflict or high-risk areas and a system for tracing the supply chain.
They must identify and assess risks of harmful effects in their supply chain, draw up a risk management plan and take measures to minimise the risks identified.
Compliance with the due diligence duties for minerals and metals is audited by an independent expert.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring articles of the same chapter on scope and exemptions, and on the annual reporting duty, which state who is covered and what must be reported rather than what must be set up.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported (fr): 'mettent en place un système de gestion'; 'plan de gestion des risques'; 'fait l'objet d'une vérification par un expert indépendant'. Scope article 964j and reporting 964l do not answer what to put in place. EN; ranks above 150.

question: Our company buys tin and gold for electronic parts, and some of it may come from regions torn by armed conflict. Assuming we fall under the Swiss supply-chain rules for such metals, what exactly do we have to put in place, and does someone outside the company have to check that we comply?

gold_facts.text: Where the articles grant a departing member a share of the cooperative's assets, the member's right to leave may be exercised in his bankruptcy by the bankruptcy administration.
If that share is seized, the right to leave may be exercised by the debt enforcement office.

provenance.critic_notes: Reworded per fix. de: 'von der Konkursverwaltung oder, wenn dieser Anteil gepfändet wird, vom Betreibungsamt'. de rank still 3, from natural terms (Statuten, Konkurs) of a short article; acceptable for easy.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: wording moved away from the article's terms (bankruptcy administration, seizure).

question: Ich bin Mitglied einer Genossenschaft, deren Statuten Mitgliedern beim Austritt einen Teil ihres Vermögens zusprechen. Gegen mich ist der Konkurs eröffnet worden. Kann jemand statt mir austreten, damit meine Gläubiger an dieses Geld kommen, und wer wäre das, wenn ein Gläubiger stattdessen auf dem Betreibungsweg darauf greift?

gold_facts.text: For defects of lesser importance, the owner may reduce the price in proportion to the loss in value or require the contractor to repair the work at its own expense if this is possible without excessive cost.
The owner may additionally claim damages if the contractor is at fault.
For repair at no cost, the rule allowing the owner to have defective work remedied by a third party applies by analogy.
Under that rule, the owner may set the contractor a reasonable deadline, warning that if it does not comply the repairs will be entrusted to a third party at the contractor's cost and risk.

competing_candidates: The contract-for-work rules on inspecting the work and notifying defects, and on the limitation of defect claims, which are preconditions rather than the remedies asked about.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported (it): 368 cpv. 2 'riparazione gratuita ... se ciò non cagioni all'appaltatore spese esorbitanti'; 'si applica per analogia l'articolo 366 capoverso 2'; 366 'affidata ad un terzo ... a rischio e spese dell'appaltatore'. Cross-ref is genuine. Fact 2 (damages if at fault) is not asked but sits in the same sentence; acceptable.

question: Un'impresa mi ha rifatto il bagno, ma ci sono alcuni difetti non gravi: posso comunque usarlo e sistemarli non costerebbe una cifra esagerata. Posso pretendere che l'impresa li ripari gratis? E se non si muove, posso farli sistemare da un altro artigiano facendo pagare a lei il conto?

gold_facts.text: Rescission of the sale may be claimed even if the thing has perished as a result of its defects or by chance.
In that case the buyer only has to return what remains of the thing.

competing_candidates: The sales rule on the mutual restitution owed after rescission, which governs what is returned in general but not the case of a destroyed item.

question: Ho comprato un'auto usata con un difetto ai freni che non era visibile e che ho segnalato subito al venditore. question: Il y a quelques années, comme associé de notre Sàrl, j'ai dû verser de l'argent en plus de mon apport, comme le prévoyaient les statuts, parce que la société était en difficulté. Aujourd'hui elle va mieux. Peut-elle me rendre cet argent, et à quelles conditions?

gold_facts.text: Where a territory or a group of customers is assigned to the travelling salesperson, he has exclusive rights to it unless otherwise agreed in writing, but the employer may still conclude deals personally with customers in that territory.

question: I'm employed as a travelling sales rep and my contract gives me a particular region to cover. Nothing in writing says otherwise. question: Mir ist ein Wechsel abhandengekommen, der in zwei Wochen fällig wird. Was kann ich sofort unternehmen, damit derjenige, der ihn bezahlen muss, das Geld nicht einem Finder auszahlt, und was geschieht dann am Fälligkeitstag mit dem Betrag?

question: Lavoro in proprio come intermediario fisso per una ditta che mi paga a provvigione. question: Avec deux amis, nous avons acheté ensemble du matériel pour un projet commun, sans créer de société inscrite au registre. Un créancier personnel de l'un de nous veut se payer sur ce matériel. Peut-il s'en prendre au matériel lui-même ou seulement à autre chose?

gold_facts.text: If the articles contain such a provision, the board of directors must, at a shareholder's request, designate an independent proxy or a corporate proxy to whom the participation rights can be delegated.

question: I hold shares in a company whose shares are not traded on any stock exchange. question: I'm about to join a cooperative whose members are personally liable for its debts. It already owes money from before I join. Will I also be liable for those older debts, and would it help if the other members agree in writing that I am not?

gold_facts.text: The commission agent must give the principal the necessary information and in particular notify him immediately of the execution of the order.

competing_candidates: General mandate rules on the mandatary's duty of care and duty to report.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported (de): 'von der Ausführung des Auftrages sofort Anzeige zu machen'; 'zur Versicherung ... nur verpflichtet, wenn er vom Kommittenten Auftrag'. DE control, rank 1 from 'Versicherung'/'sofort' and the textbook phrase 'in eigenem Namen, aber auf meine Rechnung'. Natural; borderline overlap.

question: Ich habe einen Händler beauftragt, meine Ware in eigenem Namen, aber auf meine Rechnung zu verkaufen. Über eine Versicherung haben wir nie gesprochen. Musste er die Ware bei sich versichern, und muss er mir sofort Bescheid geben, wenn er verkauft hat?

gold_facts.text: If the limited liability company has no auditor, every member may inspect the company's books and records without restriction.

competing_candidates: Information and inspection rights of shareholders in a stock company and of members of a cooperative are separate articles; the question fixes the limited liability company.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported (it): 'Se la società non ha un ufficio di revisione, ogni socio può consultare'; 'i gerenti possono rifiutare ... decide l'assemblea dei soci'; 'il giudice ordina'. question: Sono socio di una Sagl che non ha un ufficio di revisione. Voglio vedere i libri contabili e i documenti della società, ma i gerenti temono che io usi le informazioni per la mia attività concorrente e mi dicono di no. Possono rifiutare, e cosa posso fare?

gold_facts.text: A shareholder cannot be obliged, even by the articles of association, to pay more than the amount fixed for acquiring a share at its issue.

question: J'ai souscrit des actions d'une SA et payé le prix fixé lors de leur émission. gold_facts.text: A debtor who makes a payment may demand a receipt and, if he pays the whole debt, the return or cancellation of the debt instrument.

competing_candidates: Neighbouring articles on presumptions arising from a receipt and on a lost debt instrument.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported (it): 'ha diritto di chiedere una quitanza e, ove paghi l'intero debito, ... la restituzione'; 'se il pagamento non è integrale ... menzione del pagamento sul titolo'. 220:89/90 are adjacent (presumptions, lost instrument) and do not answer it. EN; all ranks null.

question: I signed an IOU when a friend lent me money. When I pay him back, can I insist on getting a written confirmation and having the IOU handed back? What if I can only pay back part of it for now?

gold_facts.text: When the company's shares are listed on a stock exchange, the articles must contain provisions on the maximum duration of contracts governing the remuneration of the board of directors, executive management and advisory board, and on the maximum notice period for contracts of indefinite duration.

question: Unsere Aktiengesellschaft geht an die Börse. Müssen wir in den Statuten etwas zur Laufzeit der Verträge regeln, mit denen Verwaltungsräte und Geschäftsleitung bezahlt werden, und wie lange dürfen solche Verträge oder ihre Kündigungsfristen höchstens sein?

question: In meinem Arbeitsvertrag steht, dass ich nach dem Austritt eine Zeit lang nicht für die Konkurrenz arbeiten darf. Mein Chef hat mir jetzt gekündigt, obwohl ich ihm keinen Grund dafür geliefert habe. Muss ich mich trotzdem an diese Klausel halten?

question: Je suis transporteur. Le destinataire refuse de prendre la marchandise (non périssable) que je lui livre. Que dois-je faire de cette marchandise, et puis-je finir par la faire vendre si personne ne s'en occupe?

question: Es gibt Berichtspflichten über Zahlungen an Regierungen für Firmen, die Erdöl, Gas oder Mineralien fördern. Gelten diese Pflichten auch für eine Firma, die solche Güter nur kauft und weiterverkauft?

question: Un'agenzia che organizza incontri per trovare moglie mi ha fatto conoscere una donna arrivata dall'estero. Dopo tre mesi lei ha deciso di tornare a casa sua. Chi deve pagarle il viaggio di ritorno, e quanto posso essere chiamato io a rimborsare all'agenzia?

question: On me propose de racheter toutes les actions d'une SA qui n'a plus aucune activité, plus de biens à vendre et dont les dettes dépassent la fortune. Un tel rachat est-il valable, et qu'est-ce que le registre du commerce peut faire de cette société?

question: My 16-year-old is starting a vocational training placement with a local company. Apart from what my child has to do, do I as a parent have any obligations towards the training company?

question: J'ai une petite menuiserie en raison individuelle et j'ai fait 300 000 francs de chiffre d'affaires l'an passé. Suis-je obligé de tenir une comptabilité complète avec bilan, ou une tenue plus simple suffit-elle?

question: Mir wurde vertraglich eine lebenslange monatliche Rente versprochen, aber die Zahlungen sind schon vor vielen Jahren ausgeblieben. Ab welchem Zeitpunkt läuft die Verjährung für meinen Rentenanspruch insgesamt, und was gilt dann für die einzelnen ausstehenden Raten?

question: Un amico mi ha regalato la sua vecchia auto. Poco dopo un guasto ai freni mi ha causato un danno. Lui non sapeva del problema. Può essere ritenuto responsabile del danno, e deve garantirmi che l'auto sia in buono stato?

question: I want to give a plot of land to my nephew, but if he dies before I do, I want it to come back to me. Can I make the gift on that condition, and can that condition be recorded in the land register?

question: Una società ha emesso più prestiti obbligazionari diversi e, essendo in difficoltà, vuole proporre a tutti i gruppi di obbligazionisti nello stesso momento una misura di risanamento. A quali condizioni la proposta si considera accettata da tutti?

question: Under a private contract I pay my aunt a lifelong pension in exchange for a sum she gave me. We never agreed on a payment schedule. How often and when do I have to pay her, and if she dies partway through a period, do I owe the whole payment for that period?
