Goods may be deposited in a warehouse without a court decision.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring provision allowing the debtor to sell perishable goods instead of depositing them covers a related remedy, but not deposit itself.
provenance.critic_notes: 'le débiteur a le droit de consigner la chose aux frais et risques du créancier' and 'Le juge décide du lieu' (92). 93 is sale; 444 carrier-specific. fr=3, paraphrased.

question: Je dois livrer des marchandises à un client, mais il refuse sans raison de les réceptionner. Puis-je les mettre en dépôt quelque part pour ne plus en être responsable, qui paie les frais et qui décide de l'endroit ?

gold_facts.text: An agreement that the rent increases periodically by a fixed amount is valid only if the lease is concluded for at least three years.
The rent may not be increased more than once a year under such an agreement.
The amount of the increase must be fixed in francs.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring rule on rents tied to the consumer price index concerns a different kind of automatic increase.
provenance.critic_notes: 'ist nur gültig, wenn: a. ... mindestens drei Jahre' (269c). 269b (indexed rent) is a different mechanism; 270d procedural. de=4, paraphrased.

question: Mein Vermieter möchte in den neuen Wohnungsmietvertrag schreiben, dass die Miete regelmässig automatisch um einen im Voraus festgelegten Betrag steigt. Unter welchen Bedingungen ist so eine Abmachung überhaupt gültig?

gold_facts.text: The employer may not reduce the worker's holidays because the worker took the other-parent leave, unless a standard or collective employment contract provides a different arrangement that is at least equivalent overall for the worker.
A worker who is the legal father at the child's birth, or becomes so within the following six months, is entitled to two weeks of other-parent leave.
The leave must be taken within six months after the child's birth.
The leave may be taken in weeks or in single days.

provenance.critic_notes: Fact 1 now has the al. 4 CTT/CCT derogation. fr: 'le congé de l'autre parent au sens de l'art. 329g'; 329g 'dans les six mois'; 'semaines ou de journées'. Both needed.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: fact 1 now includes the derogation by standard or collective employment contract.

question: I became a dad last month and want to take the two weeks off that fathers get. My boss says that if I do, he will cut my annual holidays accordingly. Is he allowed to do that, and by when do I have to take that time off and can I split it up?

gold_facts.text: The donor may revoke the gift within one year from the time he learned of the ground for revocation.
If the donor dies before that year has passed, the right of action passes to his heirs for the remainder of the period.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring provision listing the grounds for revoking a gift explains when revocation is possible, but not the time limit or the heirs' position.
provenance.critic_notes: 'La revoca ... entro un anno dal giorno in cui il donatore ne ha conosciuto la causa' and heirs for the remainder (251). 249 gives grounds only. it=207.

question: Ho regalato una bella somma a mio nipote e poi ho scoperto che si è comportato in modo gravemente scorretto nei miei confronti. Entro quanto tempo posso ancora tornare indietro sul regalo, e se dovessi morire prima di farlo, i miei figli potrebbero farlo al posto mio?

gold_facts.text: Until its relationships with the shareholders are also settled, a company in liquidation keeps its legal personality and its business name, with the addition 'in liquidation'.
From the start of liquidation, the powers of the company's bodies are limited to acts that are necessary for the liquidation and that by their nature cannot be carried out by the liquidators.

competing_candidates: Limited liability companies and cooperatives have their own liquidation provisions, some of which refer to the stock company rules; the question names a company limited by shares.
provenance.critic_notes: 'behält sie die juristische Persönlichkeit und führt ihre bisherige Firma, jedoch mit dem Zusatz «in Liquidation»' (739). Only article with that wording; GmbH/cooperative refer to AG rules (826, 913), not twins.

question: Our company limited by shares has been put into winding-up, but the shareholders have not been paid out yet. Does the company still exist as a legal entity, under what name does it trade in the meantime, and can the board of directors still take decisions?

gold_facts.text: Federal and cantonal laws may depart from the private-law rules on liability for damage caused by public officials or employees in the exercise of their official duties.
Cantonal laws may not depart from those rules for acts of public officials or employees that concern the carrying on of a trade or business.

provenance.critic_notes: 'Les lois cantonales ne peuvent déroger ... se rattachant à l'exercice d'une industrie' (61 al.2). Communal employees are public employees. fr=111.

question: Un employé communal m'a causé un dommage en accomplissant son travail officiel. Le canton peut-il prévoir ses propres règles sur la réparation de ce dommage, à la place des règles ordinaires du droit privé ? Et est-ce aussi le cas si le dommage vient d'une activité commerciale exploitée par la commune ?

gold_facts.text: The rules on leases of residential and commercial premises also apply to things that are let for use together with those premises.
Those rules do not apply to holiday homes let for a maximum of three months.

competing_candidates: A neighbouring provision restricts rent-protection rules for luxury flats and subsidised housing, which is a different exclusion.
provenance.critic_notes: 'Sie gelten nicht für Ferienwohnungen, die für höchstens drei Monate gemietet werden' (253a). 253b is a different exclusion. de=1 is mostly ordinary words; 'Ferienwohnung' is the natural term and only matches as a different token.

question: Ich miete für zwei Monate eine Ferienwohnung im Tessin. Gelten für mich die besonderen Schutzregeln, die sonst für Wohnungsmieter gelten? Und wenn ich eine normale Wohnung miete: Gelten diese Regeln auch für die Möbel, die der Vermieter mitvermietet?

gold_facts.text: A bondholder who did not agree to such a decision of the bondholders' community may challenge it in court if it violates the law or the contractual terms.
The challenge must be brought within one month (30 days in the German text) from the day the bondholder learned of the decision.

competing_candidates: The bond rule on challenging measures that restrict creditors' rights after their approval by the cantonal authority; the question states the decision does not affect creditors' rights.
provenance.critic_notes: 'Non tocca i diritti' + majority maps to 1181, so 1182 applies; 1170/1178 excluded. Fact 2 covers 30 Tage (de) vs un mese. it: 'presentare ricorso al giudice, entro il termine di un mese'. it 41.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: decision narrowed to one that does not affect creditors' rights; deadline worded to hold in all three language versions.

question: Ho obbligazioni di un'impresa. L'assemblea degli obbligazionisti ha preso a maggioranza una decisione che non tocca i nostri diritti di creditori, ma che secondo me viola la legge e le condizioni del prestito; io ho votato contro. Posso contestarla davanti a un giudice ed entro quanto tempo?

gold_facts.text: The compensation report must state the shareholdings and options on such rights of each current member of the board of directors, the executive board and the advisory board, including persons closely related to the member.
The member's name and function must be stated.

provenance.critic_notes: 'unter Nennung des Namens und der Funktion des betreffenden Mitglieds' (734d). 959c (notes to accounts) is unrelated; 663c repealed. fr=10.

question: In the yearly report on executive and board pay of a company whose shares trade on a stock exchange, does the company have to show how many of its shares and stock options each board member and executive holds, including holdings of people close to them, and must they be named?

gold_facts.text: The proceeds from issuing shares above their nominal value, less the issue costs, are allocated to the statutory capital reserve.
The statutory capital reserve may be repaid to shareholders if the statutory capital and profit reserves, less any losses, exceed half of the share capital entered in the commercial register.
The statutory profit reserve from revaluations is not taken into account when calculating that threshold.
The revaluation reserve can be dissolved only by conversion into share or participation capital, or by a value adjustment or sale of the revalued assets.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring provision on the statutory profit reserve sets a similar half-of-capital threshold for repayment of profit reserves.
provenance.critic_notes: Question equals round-4 fix verbatim; 364 chars. Gold 220:671 (Abs.1 Ziff.1, 2, 4) and 220:725c (Abs.3) and facts unchanged and supported. Paraphrased ('teurer als zum Nennwert', 'hoeher bewertet'); DE rank 52. Holding case excluded; both articles needed.
provenance.writer_note: Round 4: question rewritten per critic to avoid copying article wording.

question: Unsere AG ist keine Holding. Bei einer Kapitalerhöhung verkauften wir Aktien teurer als zum Nennwert und wollen dieses Geld den Aktionären zurückzahlen. Früher bewerteten wir zudem eine Liegenschaft höher, um einen Verlust auszugleichen. Ab welcher Reservenhöhe ist die Rückzahlung erlaubt, zählt die Höherbewertung mit, und wie kann diese später aufgelöst werden?

gold_facts.text: The general meeting decides on an ordinary increase of the share capital.
The general meeting's decision must be recorded in a public deed.
The increase must be filed for registration with the commercial register within six months of the decision, otherwise the decision lapses.

competing_candidates: Provisions on the capital band and conditional capital increase concern other ways of increasing capital; the question is about the ordinary increase in a stock company.
provenance.critic_notes: 'L'assemblée générale décide de l'augmentation ordinaire' and 'dans les six mois ... la décision est caduque' (650). Control item, fr=8. GmbH 781 refers to AG rules; not a twin given 'société anonyme'.

question: Notre société anonyme veut augmenter son capital de la manière habituelle, en émettant de nouvelles actions. Qui doit prendre cette décision, sous quelle forme, et dans quel délai faut-il ensuite la faire inscrire au registre du commerce ?

gold_facts.text: The maturity of a bill payable at a fixed period after sight is determined by the date of acceptance or by the date of the protest.
Without a protest, an undated acceptance is deemed, as regards the acceptor, to have been given on the last day of the period for presentation for acceptance.

competing_candidates: The provision on acceptance of bills payable after sight (dating of the acceptance and protest for an undated acceptance) is related; the rules for promissory notes payable after sight are separate.
provenance.critic_notes: 'gilt dem Annehmer gegenüber der Wechsel als am letzten Tage der ... Frist angenommen' (1025 Abs.2). 1015 Abs.2 requires dating/protest but not the deemed date; 1099 is promissory notes. de=1 unavoidable technical terms (Wechsel, Protest).

question: Ich halte einen gezogenen Wechsel, der eine bestimmte Zeit nach Vorlage fällig wird. Der Bezogene hat ihn angenommen, aber kein Datum dazugeschrieben, und es wurde kein Protest erhoben. Wonach richtet sich die Fälligkeit, und an welchem Tag gilt die Annahme gegenüber dem Annehmenden als erfolgt?

gold_facts.text: The agent is presumed to be authorised to receive customers' notices of defects and other declarations by which they assert or reserve rights for defective performance by the principal.
The agent is presumed not to be authorised to receive payments, grant extensions of payment or agree other changes to the contract with customers.

competing_candidates: The employment-law rule on the powers of a salaried commercial traveller (excluded: the question states the person is not an employee).
provenance.critic_notes: Independence now stated, so 220:348b is excluded. it: 'non è autorizzato a ricevere pagamenti, a concedere dilazioni'. IT rank 1 comes from the natural term 'agente' plus 'clienti'; same-language control, tolerable.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: states the representative is independent, not an employee. Fact 1 trimmed to the part the question asks.

question: La ditta per cui lavoro si affida a un agente indipendente, che non è suo dipendente, e che le procura clienti in modo stabile. Se nel contratto non si dice nulla, questa persona può incassare i soldi dai clienti o concedere loro più tempo per pagare? E può almeno ricevere i reclami dei clienti per merce difettosa?

gold_facts.text: The warehouse keeper must take the same care in keeping the goods as a commission agent.
Where possible, the warehouse keeper must notify the depositor when changes in the goods seem to require further measures.
The warehouse keeper must let the depositor inspect the goods and take samples during business hours, and take necessary protective measures at any time.

competing_candidates: The general rules on deposit contracts set the ordinary depositary's duties, but not the warehouse-specific ones.
provenance.critic_notes: 'Er hat ihm die Besichtigung der Güter und Entnahme von Proben ... zu gestatten' (483). 472ff general deposit lacks these duties. No lexical signal.

question: I keep goods stored with a commercial warehouse company. How carefully does the warehouse have to look after them, does it have to tell me if they start to change in a way that needs action, and am I allowed to go and check on them?

gold_facts.text: If the buyer loses the thing entirely to a third party's right, the sale is deemed cancelled and the buyer may claim back the price with interest, less the benefits he obtained or failed to obtain.

The buyer may also claim his expenses on the thing not recoverable from the third party, the court and out-of-court costs of the lawsuit except those that notifying the seller of the litigation would have avoided, and other damage directly caused.
The seller must also compensate further damage unless he proves that he was not at fault at all.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring provisions on the seller's warranty of title, the notice of litigation and partial loss of the thing are related; the question states the loss is total.
provenance.critic_notes: 'En cas d'éviction totale, la vente est réputée résiliée' and listed claims (195). 192/193/196 related but total loss stated. fr=5, paraphrased.

question: J'ai acheté une voiture d'occasion, puis le véritable propriétaire me l'a reprise entièrement à l'issue d'un procès. Qu'est-ce que je peux réclamer au vendeur ?

gold_facts.text: After the probation period, a worker may not terminate the employment while a superior whose functions he can perform, or the employer, is prevented from working for the reasons listed for compulsory service and the worker has to take over that activity during the absence.
The protected reasons include Swiss compulsory military, civil protection or civilian service.
A notice given during the protected period is void; if given before it, the part of the notice period not yet expired is suspended and resumes only after the period ends.
If the employment must end on a fixed date such as the end of a month, the extended notice period is prolonged to the next such date.

provenance.critic_notes: 336d Abs.1 refers to 336c Abs.1 lit.a; 336d Abs.2 applies 336c Abs.2-3 ('ce délai est suspendu'). Both needed. fr=1 from standard terms (délai de congé, service militaire).
provenance.writer_note: Article A refers to the conditions of the first letter of Article B's first paragraph (compulsory service), not to illness; the question is built on military service accordingly.

question: Mon supérieur direct part plusieurs semaines faire son service militaire obligatoire, et c'est moi qui dois reprendre son travail pendant son absence, ce dont je suis capable. Ma période d'essai est terminée. Ai-je le droit de démissionner pendant ce temps ? Et si j'avais déjà donné mon congé avant son départ, qu'advient-il du délai de congé ?

gold_facts.text: If the obligation is to refrain from doing something, a debtor who breaches it owes damages by the mere fact of the breach.
The creditor may also demand removal of what was done in breach of the promise, or be authorised to remove it himself at the debtor's expense.

competing_candidates: If the restriction were registered as an easement, the Civil Code rules on servitudes and landowner liability could also apply; the question frames it as a contractual promise.
provenance.critic_notes: 'so hat er schon bei blossem Zuwiderhandeln den Schaden zu ersetzen' (98 Abs.2). Easement rules not triggered by a contractual promise. de=4, paraphrased.

question: Ich habe meinem Nachbarn ein Stück Land verkauft, und im Vertrag hat er sich verpflichtet, darauf keine Werbetafel aufzustellen. Jetzt steht trotzdem eine da. Schuldet er mir schon deshalb Schadenersatz, und kann ich verlangen, dass die Tafel wieder verschwindet?

gold_facts.text: The members' meeting is convened by the managing directors, if necessary by the auditors; the liquidators also have the right to convene it.
The ordinary meeting is held every year within six months after the end of the financial year.
The meeting must be convened at least 20 days in advance; the articles of association may extend this period or shorten it to as little as ten days.

competing_candidates: The stock company rules on convening the general meeting use similar periods; the question names a limited liability company.
provenance.critic_notes: 'convocata almeno 20 giorni prima ... abbreviarlo sino a dieci giorni' (805). AG twins 699/700 have no ten-day shortening and question names Sagl. it=1 from generic terms (assemblea dei soci, statuto).

question: Sono socio di una Sagl. Chi deve convocare l'assemblea dei soci, entro quanto tempo dalla chiusura dell'esercizio deve tenersi quella annuale, e con quanto preavviso va convocata? Lo statuto può cambiare questo preavviso?

gold_facts.text: If the lease includes equipment, livestock or stocks, each party must give the other an exact inventory signed by it.
The parties must take part in a joint valuation of those items.

competing_candidates: Provisions on returning the inventory and replacing its value at the end of the lease are related but concern the end, not the start.
provenance.critic_notes: 'muss jede Partei der andern ein genaues, von ihr unterzeichnetes Verzeichnis ... übergeben' (277). 299b concerns end of lease. No lexical signal.

question: I am taking over a village inn as a going concern: I run it and keep the earnings, and the lease includes the kitchen equipment and the stock of food and drink. Do the owner and I have to list these items in writing at the start, and how is their value set?

gold_facts.text: A credit contract financing goods or services must additionally contain a description of the goods or services and both the cash price and the price payable under the credit contract.
It must state any down payment and the number, amount and due dates of the instalments, or the method for determining them if still unknown when the contract is concluded.
If ownership does not pass to the consumer immediately, it must name the owner of the goods and the conditions under which the consumer becomes owner.

competing_candidates: The general list of mandatory contents for any consumer credit contract applies as well and could be retrieved; the question asks what must be stated in addition for a purchase financed by credit.
provenance.critic_notes: 10 supports all facts (de: 'die Person des Eigentümers, sofern das Eigentum nicht sofort'). 9 (cash credit) does not cover ownership; ZGB retention of title not needed. DE rank 183.

question: Ich kaufe im Möbelhaus ein Sofa und bezahle es über einen Kredit in Raten ab. Was muss in so einem Kreditvertrag zusätzlich drinstehen, zum Beispiel wem das Sofa gehört, solange ich es nicht fertig abbezahlt habe?

gold_facts.text: A lender is any natural or legal person who grants consumer credit on a professional basis.
A person who grants consumer credit without acting professionally, but through a crowdlending broker, is also a lender.

competing_candidates: The definition of the crowdlending broker / credit intermediary in the same section may also be retrieved.
provenance.critic_notes: 2 supports both facts (fr: 'sans agir par métier, par l'intermédiaire d'un courtier en crédit participatif'). Same-language control, FR rank 1: 'prêteur' is the ordinary word and hard to avoid; no other article defines it. Near-topic duplicate of s-0158.

question: Je prête de temps en temps de petites sommes à des particuliers via une plateforme de financement participatif en ligne, sans en faire ma profession. Est-ce que je compte quand même comme prêteur au sens de la loi sur le crédit à la consommation ?

gold_facts.text: The contract must state the effective annual interest rate or, if that is not possible, the annual interest rate and the costs charged at conclusion.
The Federal Council sets the maximum permitted interest rate for that effective annual rate, taking into account the refinancing rates determined by the National Bank.
The maximum interest rate should as a rule not exceed 15 percent.

competing_candidates: The articles on contract contents for credit card / overdraft credit and leasing also require stating an interest rate.
provenance.critic_notes: Now asks the statutory limit. de 14: 'soll in der Regel 15 Prozent nicht überschreiten'; 9(2)(b) effective annual rate. 'cash loan' separates 9 from 10/11. Both needed.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: asks for the statutory limit, not the ordinance figure. Dropped the written-form fact, which the question does not ask.

question: I am taking out a cash loan from a consumer lender. Which figure about the yearly cost of the loan has to be written in my contract, and is there a legal ceiling on that rate? Who fixes it, and what upper limit does the law itself set as a rule?

gold_facts.text: The authorisation is granted if the applicant guarantees irreproachable business conduct and is in a sound financial situation.
The applicant must have the necessary commercial and professional knowledge and skills and sufficient professional liability insurance.
Companies and legal entities are authorised only if all members of management have the required knowledge and skills.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring article on the duty to obtain an authorisation and the competent canton could be retrieved for the same situation, but does not list the conditions.
provenance.critic_notes: 40 al.1-2 supports all facts (it: 'tutti i membri della direzione posseggano le conoscenze'). 39 (duty, exemptions) not asked. IT rank 13, paraphrased.

question: Voglio avviare un'attività che concede piccoli prestiti a privati e mi serve il permesso del cantone. Quali requisiti devo soddisfare per ottenerlo e, se apro una società, cosa si chiede alle persone che la dirigono?

gold_facts.text: If the entitled person has pledged the rights under a life insurance contract to the insurer, the insurer may set off its claim against the surrender value of the insurance.
The insurer may do so only after unsuccessfully demanding, in writing or text form and with a warning of the consequences of default, that the debtor pay within six months of receiving the demand.

competing_candidates: General Civil Code rules on the pledge of claims and Code of Obligations rules on set-off are topically close.
provenance.critic_notes: 95 supports both facts (fr: 'compenser sa créance avec la valeur de rachat'). 73 (pledge of policy in general) does not give set-off. FR rank 22.

question: J'ai mis mon assurance-vie en garantie auprès de ma propre compagnie d'assurance pour obtenir une avance. Si je ne rembourse pas, la compagnie peut-elle simplement se payer sur ce que vaudrait ma police si je la résiliais, et que doit-elle faire avant ?

gold_facts.text: If the same interest is insured against the same risk for the same period with several insurers and the total sums insured exceed the insured value, the policyholder must notify each insurer without delay in writing or text form.
A policyholder who did not know of the multiple insurance when concluding a further contract may withdraw from that contract in writing or text form within four weeks of discovering it.

competing_candidates: The following article on how liability is shared among several insurers concerns the same situation but not withdrawal or notification.
provenance.critic_notes: 46b al.1-2 supports both facts (de: 'innert vier Wochen seit der Entdeckung der Mehrfachversicherung'). EN, no lexical signal.

question: I took out a new home contents policy with a second company without realising my old policy elsewhere was still running, so together they cover more than my belongings are worth. Can I get out of the new policy, by when, and what do I have to tell the insurers?

gold_facts.text: For good cause, an insurance contract may be terminated at any time in writing or in another form allowing proof by text.
Good cause includes any circumstance under which continuing the contract can no longer be expected of the terminating party in good faith.

competing_candidates: The insurance act also has ordinary termination rules and termination after a claim, which do not cover termination for good cause.
provenance.critic_notes: 35b supports both facts (de: 'Aus wichtigem Grund kann der Vertrag jederzeit schriftlich'). 35a (ordinary termination) does not answer immediacy. Same-language control, DE rank 98.

question: Meine Versicherung hat mich so schwer hintergangen, dass ich mit ihr nichts mehr zu tun haben will. Darf ich den Vertrag mitten in der Laufzeit sofort beenden, und in welcher Form muss ich das tun?

gold_facts.text: If the policyholder goes bankrupt, the insurance contract continues and the bankruptcy administration is responsible for its performance, subject to the rule on beneficiaries stepping in.

If the beneficiaries of a life insurance are the policyholder's spouse, registered partner or descendants, they step into the rights and obligations under the contract when the policyholder is declared bankrupt, unless they expressly refuse.
The beneficiaries must notify the insurer of the transfer by producing a certificate from the debt enforcement office or the bankruptcy administration.
If there are several beneficiaries, they must appoint a representative to receive the insurer's communications.

competing_candidates: The life insurance article excluding claims from enforcement when spouse or descendants are beneficiaries is topically close.
provenance.critic_notes: 46a al.1 and 81 al.1-2 support facts (de: 'treten sie, sofern sie es nicht ausdrücklich ablehnen... ein'). 46a reserves 81, so both needed. DE rank 1 comes from everyday words (Konkurs, Lebensversicherung, Begünstigte); acceptable.

question: Mein Mann ist in Konkurs gegangen. Er hat eine Lebensversicherung, bei der ich und unsere Kinder als Begünstigte eingetragen sind. Läuft der Vertrag einfach weiter und kümmert sich das Konkursamt darum, oder übernehmen wir ihn? Was müssen wir dafür gegenüber der Versicherung tun?

gold_facts.text: A person who has proposed an insurance contract to the insurer remains bound for fourteen days unless a shorter acceptance period was set.
The proposer remains bound for four weeks if the insurance requires a medical examination.
The period starts when the proposal is handed over or sent to the insurer or its agent, and the proposer is released if the acceptance has not reached them before it expires.

competing_candidates: General Code of Obligations rules on how long an offer binds are topically close but the insurance-specific rule governs.
provenance.critic_notes: 1 al.1-4 supports all facts (it: 'Rimane vincolato per quattro settimane se l'assicurazione richiede una visita medica'). 220:5 is the general offer rule; VVG special rule clearly answers. Same-language control, IT rank 57.

question: Ho inviato a una compagnia la richiesta di stipulare un'assicurazione sulla vita per la quale serve un controllo dal medico. Se la compagnia non mi risponde, per quanto tempo devo tenere ferma la mia richiesta e da quando si conta?

gold_facts.text: The applicant must disclose to the insurer, based on a questionnaire or other questioning, all facts relevant to assessing the risk, as far as they know or should know them; questions and answers must be in writing or text form.
Relevant facts are those capable of influencing the insurer's decision to conclude the contract at all or on the agreed terms.
Risk facts targeted by specific and unambiguous questions of the insurer are presumed to be relevant.

competing_candidates: The following article on the consequences of a breach of the disclosure duty is close, but the question asks only about the content of the duty.
provenance.critic_notes: de Art.4(3): «Gefahrstatsachen ... in bestimmter, unzweideutiger Fassung ... werden als erheblich vermutet.» All facts supported in de/fr/it. Closest: 221.229.1:6 (consequences of breach), 221.229.1:5 (representative); neither answers. fr rank 16, paraphrased.

question: Avant de souscrire une assurance, on me fait remplir une liste de questions sur ma situation. Qu'est-ce que je dois exactement indiquer à l'assureur, sous quelle forme, et une question posée clairement compte-t-elle forcément comme importante ?

gold_facts.text: The controller must take technical and organisational measures so that processing complies with data protection rules, and must do so from the design of the processing.
The measures must be appropriate having regard in particular to the state of the art, the type and extent of processing, and the risk to the personality or fundamental rights of the data subjects.
Through appropriate default settings, the controller must ensure that processing is limited to the minimum required by the purpose, unless the data subject decides otherwise.

competing_candidates: The data security article also requires technical and organisational measures, but for security rather than design and defaults.
provenance.critic_notes: fr: «Il le fait dès la conception du traitement.» All three facts map to al.1-3 in de/fr/it. Closest: 235.1:8 (data security) does not cover design or defaults. de rank 28.

question: Wir entwickeln eine App, die Daten unserer Kundinnen und Kunden sammelt. Müssen wir den Datenschutz schon beim Programmieren mitdenken, wonach richtet sich, wie viel Aufwand wir treiben müssen, und wie sollen die Standardeinstellungen der App aussehen?

gold_facts.text: Private persons who breach their information or access obligations by intentionally giving false or incomplete information are punished, on complaint, with a fine of up to CHF 250,000.

competing_candidates: The data protection article on the right of access sets the duty to answer but not the penalty.
provenance.critic_notes: it: «Sono puniti, a querela di parte, con la multa fino a 250 000 franchi»; lit.a covers incomplete answers under Art.25. Closest: 235.1:25 (duty only), 235.1:61 (other penalties). de rank 9 is incidental (Busse/Auskunft).
provenance.writer_note: The provisions referred to in letter a are masked; the link to the access duty rests on the article title, which names the duty to grant access.

question: J'ai demandé à une entreprise quelles informations elle garde sur moi, et elle m'a sciemment donné une réponse incomplète. Est-ce punissable, avec quelle peine, et faut-il que je dépose plainte pour que ce soit poursuivi ?

gold_facts.text: If personal data are processed exclusively for publication in the editorial part of a periodical medium, the controller may refuse, restrict or defer access if the data reveal the sources of information.
Access may also be refused, restricted or deferred if it would give insight into drafts of publications or if publication would endanger the free formation of public opinion.
Media professionals may also refuse, restrict or defer access if the data serve them exclusively as a personal work tool.

competing_candidates: The general restrictions on the right of access in the data protection act are topically close.
provenance.critic_notes: de: «kann der Verantwortliche ... die Auskunft verweigern, einschränken oder aufschieben» (media). 235.1:26 general grounds also apply to a newspaper but do not give the media grounds; partial only. Fact 3 (journalist personal work tool) is marginal for «il giornale» but within scope.

question: Ho chiesto a un settimanale quali dati personali su di me sta usando per un'inchiesta che sta preparando. Il giornale può rifiutarsi di rispondermi o rimandare la risposta, e per quali motivi?

gold_facts.text: In answering an access request, the controller must state, where applicable, the recipients or categories of recipients to whom personal data are disclosed.

Where personal data are disclosed abroad, the data subject must be told the name of the state or international body receiving them and, where applicable, the safeguards relied on or the statutory exception applied.
The controller must provide the requested information free of charge, subject to exceptions the Federal Council may provide, in particular for disproportionate effort.
As a rule, the information must be provided within 30 days.

competing_candidates: The Data Protection Act articles on disclosure of personal data abroad (adequacy, safeguards, exceptions), which set the conditions for the transfer itself rather than what the data subject is told.
provenance.critic_notes: fr 25(2)(g): «les destinataires ... ainsi que les informations prévues à l’art. 19, al. 4.» 19(4) gives state and safeguards, so both articles needed; 25(6),(7) give free of charge and 30 days. Closest: 235.1:16-17 (transfer conditions). No lexical signal.

question: I asked an online shop to tell me what it knows about me. I know it hands some of my details to a service company outside Switzerland. When it answers me, what does it have to say about who receives my data and about the foreign destination, and can it charge me or take months to reply?

gold_facts.text: Federal bodies may in principle disclose personal data only if there is a legal basis for it.
On request, federal bodies may disclose a person's surname, first name, address and date of birth even if the general conditions for disclosure are not met.

Federal bodies must refuse, restrict or impose conditions on a disclosure if an important public interest, a manifestly legitimate interest of the data subject, a statutory duty of secrecy or a special data protection provision requires it.

competing_candidates: The Data Protection Act article on the legal basis required for processing by federal bodies (it sets the general requirement, not the address-data exception).
provenance.critic_notes: it 36(4): «possono comunicare, su richiesta, cognome, nome, indirizzo e data di nascita»; 36(6) refusal grounds. Facts supported in de/fr/it. Closest: 235.1:34 (legal basis). de rank 79.

question: Ein Bundesamt hat einer Privatperson auf deren Anfrage mitgeteilt, wie ich heisse, wo ich wohne und wann ich geboren bin. Ich habe nie zugestimmt, und ein Gesetz, das genau das erlaubt, gibt es meines Wissens nicht. Darf eine Bundesbehörde solche Angaben einfach herausgeben, und wann müsste sie es verweigern?

gold_facts.text: The controller may refuse, restrict or defer the handover or transfer of personal data on the same grounds that allow it to refuse, restrict or defer information under the right of access.
The controller must state the reason for which it refuses, restricts or defers the handover or transfer.

competing_candidates: The Data Protection Act article on restrictions of the right of access, which lists the grounds that this article borrows.
The Data Protection Act article establishing the right to data portability itself.
provenance.critic_notes: fr: «Le responsable du traitement indique le motif pour lequel il refuse». Same-language control, fr rank 1, but the question paraphrases (fichier, retarder) and avoids the article title terms. Closest: 235.1:28 (right itself), 235.1:26 (grounds borrowed).

question: J'ai demandé à mon opérateur de téléphonie de me donner mes données dans un fichier que je peux reprendre chez un concurrent, ou de les envoyer directement à ce concurrent. Il refuse sans rien dire. A-t-il le droit de refuser ou de retarder cela, et doit-il au moins m'expliquer pourquoi?

gold_facts.text: The court may require the advertiser to prove the factual accuracy of factual claims made in advertising.
It may do so if this appears appropriate in the individual case, taking into account the legitimate interests of the advertiser and of the other parties to the proceedings.

competing_candidates: The Civil Code article on the general allocation of the burden of proof (it states the default rule, not the shift for advertising claims).
provenance.critic_notes: it: «Il giudice può esigere dall’inserzionista la prova dell’esattezza materiale delle allegazioni di fatto». Facts supported in de/fr/it (para 2 repealed). Closest: 210:8 (general burden of proof, default only). No lexical signal.

question: A competitor has sued my company because our TV ad says our vacuum cleaner uses half the electricity of other brands. Normally they would have to prove the ad is wrong, but can the court instead make us prove that what we claim in the ad is actually true?

gold_facts.text: For measurable goods and services offered to consumers for purchase, the quantity and the price must be indicated.
Their comparability must be ensured by indicating the unit price.
The Federal Council may issue rules whose observance exempts from the duty to indicate the unit price.

competing_candidates: The Unfair Competition Act article on the general duty to indicate the actual price to consumers (it covers the selling price, not the unit price for comparison).
provenance.critic_notes: de: «deren Vergleichbarkeit durch Grundpreisbekanntgabe zu gewährleisten». Facts supported. fr rank 14; question avoids «prix unitaire». Closest: 241:16 (selling price only), 241:24 (penalty).

question: Au supermarché, le fromage râpé est vendu en sachets de tailles différentes, et l'étiquette n'indique que le prix du sachet. Je n'arrive pas à comparer lequel est le plus avantageux. Le magasin est-il obligé d'indiquer aussi combien coûte par exemple un kilo?

gold_facts.text: The competent cantonal bodies may obtain information and require documents as far as needed to establish the facts.
Persons and firms that offer goods to consumers for purchase are subject to the duty to provide information.
The duty to provide information lapses where testimony may be refused under the Federal Act on Federal Civil Procedure.

Anyone who intentionally breaches the duty to provide information in connection with price indication is liable to a fine of up to 20,000 francs; if the offender acts negligently, the penalty is a fine.

provenance.critic_notes: de 24(1)(d): «die Auskunftspflicht im Zusammenhang mit der Preisbekanntgabe (Art. 19) verletzt»; 19(3) gives the refusal case. Both articles needed. Same-language control, de rank 5; «Auskünfte und Unterlagen» echoes 19(1) but acceptable for a control item.

question: Ich führe einen Kiosk. Das kantonale Amt will von mir Auskünfte und Unterlagen dazu, wie ich die Preise meiner Waren anschreibe. Muss ich überhaupt antworten, gibt es Fälle, in denen ich schweigen darf, und was droht mir, wenn ich die Angaben absichtlich verweigere?

gold_facts.text: It is unfair to offer, promise or grant an undue advantage to an employee or other auxiliary of a third party in the private sector to induce an act or omission in breach of duty or within his or her discretion in connection with his or her work.
It is likewise unfair for such an employee or auxiliary to request, accept a promise of or accept an undue advantage for such an act or omission.
Advantages contractually accepted by the third party and minor advantages that are socially customary are not undue.

competing_candidates: Private bribery offences in the Swiss Criminal Code, which is not among the 8 acts.
provenance.critic_notes: it: «Non sono indebiti i vantaggi accettati contrattualmente dal terzo né quelli di esigua entità». Facts supported. No other article on private bribery in the 8 acts (Criminal Code not in corpus). it rank 149.

question: Un fornitore ha regalato al nostro responsabile acquisti un fine settimana in un albergo di lusso perché scegliesse la sua offerta e non quella più conveniente di un altro. Questo è permesso? E i piccoli omaggi di Natale, come una bottiglia di vino, sono un problema?

gold_facts.text: The arbitral award can be challenged by an appeal to the Federal Supreme Court.
The procedure is governed by the Federal Supreme Court Act unless the arbitration chapter on appeals provides otherwise.

competing_candidates: The Civil Procedure Code article allowing the parties to agree that the award may be challenged before the cantonal court instead; excluded here because nothing was agreed.
The Civil Procedure Code articles on revision of an arbitral award, a separate remedy.
provenance.critic_notes: it: «Il lodo è impugnabile mediante ricorso al Tribunale federale.» Closest: 272:390 (cantonal court only by express agreement, excluded by «nothing agreed»). Domestic seat stated. No lexical signal.

question: Wir haben als Schweizer Firma ein Schiedsverfahren gegen eine andere Schweizer Firma verloren; das Schiedsgericht sass in Bern. Im Schiedsvertrag haben wir nichts darüber vereinbart, wie man den Entscheid anfechten kann. An welches Gericht müssen wir uns wenden, und nach welchen Verfahrensregeln läuft das?

gold_facts.text: The arbitral tribunal may require an advance on the expected costs and make the conduct of the proceedings dependent on its payment.
If a party does not pay its advance, the other party may advance the entire costs or withdraw from the arbitration.
If it withdraws from the arbitration, it may start new arbitration proceedings for the same dispute or bring an action before the state court.

provenance.critic_notes: de: «kann sie für diese Streitsache ein neues Schiedsverfahren einleiten oder Klage vor dem staatlichen Gericht erheben». it rank 1 via core terms (arbitrato, anticipo, spese), no rare phrase. Closest: 272:98 (advance in state court).

question: In un arbitrato con sede in Svizzera tra la mia ditta e un'altra ditta svizzera, il tribunale arbitrale ha chiesto a ciascuna parte di versare un anticipo per le spese. L'altra ditta non paga la sua parte. Che cosa posso fare, e se rinuncio all'arbitrato posso ancora far valere la mia pretesa altrove?

gold_facts.text: The court instructs the expert and puts the questions for the expert opinion to him or her in writing or orally at a hearing.
The court gives the parties the opportunity to comment on the questions and to propose amendments or additions.
The court makes the necessary files available to the expert and sets a deadline for submitting the report.

competing_candidates: Civil Procedure Code articles on the appointment of the expert and on the expert's report.
provenance.critic_notes: fr: «Il donne aux parties l’occasion de s’exprimer sur les questions soumises à expertise»; 185(3) deadline. Closest: 272:183 (appointment), 272:187 (report). No lexical signal.

question: In my civil lawsuit over defects in my new house, the court is appointing a construction specialist to give an opinion. Do the parties get any say in what exactly the specialist is asked to look into, and does the specialist get a deadline?

gold_facts.text: The conciliation authority examines any documents and may carry out an inspection.
If a proposed judgment or a decision on the merits comes into consideration, the conciliation authority may also take other evidence, provided this does not unduly delay the proceedings.
The conciliation authority may submit a proposed judgment to the parties in other financial disputes with a value in dispute of up to 10,000 francs.

competing_candidates: The Civil Procedure Code article on a decision on the merits by the conciliation authority, which applies to smaller financial claims and so does not cover a 7,000-franc claim.
provenance.critic_notes: it 210(1)(c): «nelle altre controversie patrimoniali fino a un valore litigioso di 10 000 franchi». 203(2) makes other evidence depend on 210/212, so 210 is needed for the 7,000 case. Closest: 272:212 (decision up to 2,000, excluded).

question: I filed a claim for an unpaid invoice of 7,000 francs, and first we have to go to the conciliation authority. At that hearing, will they only look at the papers, or can they also hear my witness? And can the authority itself put forward a proposed outcome in a case like mine?

gold_facts.text: A party that intends to take recourse against a third person if it loses, or that fears a claim by a third person, may call on that person to support it in the proceedings.
The person so called may in turn notify a further person of the dispute.

competing_candidates: The following civil procedure articles on the position of the notified third person and on the qualified third-party notice (an action against the third person), which concern effects or a different remedy, not the basic right to call the third person in.
provenance.critic_notes: de: «kann diese auffordern, sie im Prozess zu unterstützen.» 78(2) further notice. fr rank 6 from common words. Closest: 272:79 (position of notified party), 272:81 (qualified notice).

question: Un client me poursuit en justice parce qu'une machine que je lui ai vendue est défectueuse. Je l'avais moi-même achetée chez un fournisseur, contre qui je compte me retourner si je perds. Est-ce que je peux faire venir ce fournisseur dans le procès pour qu'il m'aide à me défendre, et lui, peut-il à son tour y faire participer son propre fournisseur ?

gold_facts.text: The parties may freely agree on the number of arbitrators.
If there is no agreement, there are three arbitrators.
If the parties agreed on an even number, it is presumed that an additional arbitrator is to be appointed as chair.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring arbitration articles on how arbitrators are appointed by the parties or by the state court, which do not set the number.
provenance.critic_notes: fr: «À défaut de convention, les arbitres sont au nombre de trois.» de rank 1 though «Schiedsrichter» is not in the de text; common words only. Closest: 272:361 (appointment). Domestic parties stated.

question: Mein Geschäftspartner und ich, beide in der Schweiz ansässig, haben im Vertrag festgehalten, dass Streitigkeiten nicht vor ein staatliches Gericht, sondern vor ein privates Schiedsgericht kommen. Wie viele Schiedsrichter es sein sollen, steht nirgends. Mit wie vielen muss ich rechnen, und was würde gelten, wenn wir zwei vereinbart hätten?

gold_facts.text: The joint petition must contain the names and addresses of the spouses and, where applicable, of their representative.
It must contain the joint request for divorce, the complete agreement on the effects of the divorce and the joint motions concerning the children.
It must include the necessary documents, the date and the signatures.

competing_candidates: The following civil procedure article on a joint petition with only partial agreement, and the Civil Code article on divorce on joint request (substantive conditions, not the content of the filing).
provenance.critic_notes: fr: «la convention complète sur les effets du divorce». Facts map to lit. a-f. Closest: 272:286 (partial agreement, excluded by «d’accordo su tutto»), 210:111 (substantive). No lexical signal.

question: Mia moglie e io abbiamo deciso di lasciarci definitivamente e siamo d'accordo proprio su tutto: casa, soldi, alimenti e figli. Vogliamo rivolgerci insieme al tribunale per divorziare. Che cosa deve contenere il documento che depositiamo insieme?

gold_facts.text: Before every payment on account, even a provisional one, the liquidators must send the creditors an extract of the distribution list.
The distribution list must be made available for inspection for ten days.
During the inspection period the distribution list can be challenged by complaint to the supervisory authority.

competing_candidates: The bankruptcy articles on the distribution list and payments on account in bankruptcy; the question concerns a composition with assignment of assets, not bankruptcy.
provenance.critic_notes: DE: 'Vor jeder, auch bloss provisorischen, Abschlagszahlung ... Auszug ... zehn Tagen'. IT text says only 'compilare un estratto ... a disposizione', DE/FR say sent; fine. Bankruptcy twins 281.1:263/266 are distinguished by the composition-with-assignment framing.

question: Eine Firma, die mir Geld schuldet, hat mit ihren Gläubigern vereinbart, dass ihr ganzes Vermögen verwertet und der Erlös unter uns aufgeteilt wird. Die Personen, die das abwickeln, kündigen nun eine erste Teilzahlung an. Muss man mir vorher zeigen, wie das Geld verteilt wird, und wie kann ich mich wehren, wenn ich die Aufteilung für falsch halte?

gold_facts.text: If enforcement is directed against a spouse living under community of property, the payment order and all other enforcement documents must also be served on the other spouse.
If this property regime is only raised during the proceedings, the office makes the omitted notifications without delay.
Each spouse may raise an objection.

competing_candidates: The following enforcement article on the special rules for contesting which assets may be seized from the community property.
The Civil Code articles on liability of spouses under community of property (substantive liability, not service of documents).
provenance.critic_notes: IT: 'devono essere notificati anche all'altro coniuge'; 'Ciascun coniuge può fare opposizione'. All 3 facts supported. 281.1:68b (contesting community assets) and ZGB liability rules do not answer service/objection. Ranks high, no copying.

question: Mio marito e io abbiamo firmato un contratto matrimoniale con cui tutto il nostro patrimonio è messo in comune. Un creditore ha avviato una procedura per farsi pagare un debito solo contro di lui. Devo ricevere anch'io i documenti di questa procedura, e posso oppormi io stessa all'ordine di pagamento?

gold_facts.text: A set-off can be contested if the bankrupt's debtor, before the opening of bankruptcy but knowing of the bankrupt's insolvency, acquired a claim against the bankrupt.
This applies where the claim was acquired in order to obtain, through the set-off, an advantage for himself or a third party to the detriment of the estate.

competing_candidates: The preceding bankruptcy article listing cases where set-off is excluded outright, mostly for claims acquired after the opening of bankruptcy; the question concerns an acquisition before the opening.
provenance.critic_notes: FR: 'La compensation peut être contestée lorsque le débiteur du failli a acquis, avant l'ouverture'. 281.1:213 covers acquisition after opening; 281.1:288 general avoidance is less specific. Question paraphrases well (no rank <1000 in any lang).

question: A company went bankrupt last month. Shortly before, one of its customers, who owed it 50,000 francs and knew the company could no longer pay its debts, bought another creditor's claim against the company at a discount, so it could offset that claim against its own debt instead of paying in full. Can this offset be challenged?

gold_facts.text: A creditor who did not agree to the composition keeps his rights against co-debtors, sureties and persons liable on recourse.

A creditor who agreed to the composition also keeps those rights if he informed those persons at least ten days in advance of the date and place of the creditors' meeting and offered them assignment of his claim against payment.
If several co-obligors are declared bankrupt at the same time, the creditor can assert his full claim in each bankruptcy.

competing_candidates: Code of Obligations rules on joint and several debtors and on sureties, which deal with recourse between obligors but not with the effect of a composition or simultaneous bankruptcies.
provenance.critic_notes: Still needs 303 al.1-2 (voting for composition, how to keep rights vs co-debtors) and 216 al.1 (same-day bankruptcies, full claim in each). Terse but natural FR; FR rank 2 from generic words.

question: Une entreprise me doit 80 000 francs; deux personnes ont signé avec elle en s'engageant chacune à payer toute la dette. Elle propose un accord à ses créanciers pour ne payer qu'une partie, et j'envisage de voter pour. Perds-je mes droits contre elles, et comment les garder ? Si elles étaient déclarées en faillite le même jour, pour quel montant m'annoncer dans chacune ?

gold_facts.text: If the debtor has died or fled, all adults who lived in a common household with him have the same duty as the debtor, under threat of penalty, to disclose and hand over his assets to the bankruptcy office.
These persons must open rooms and containers for the official on request, and the official may call in the police if necessary.
The bankruptcy office must expressly inform the persons concerned of their duties and of the penalties.

competing_candidates: The seizure-enforcement article on the debtor's and third parties' duty to disclose assets, which applies to seizure, not bankruptcy.
provenance.critic_notes: FR al.2: 'Si le failli est décédé ou en fuite, ces obligations incombent ... aux personnes adultes'; al.3 open rooms, police; al.6 inform. Supported de/fr/it. Seizure analogue 281.1:91 distinguished by bankruptcy framing.

question: Mon frère, qui habitait chez moi, a été déclaré en faillite puis il est parti à l'étranger sans laisser d'adresse. L'office des faillites me demande d'indiquer quels biens il possède et d'ouvrir sa chambre et ses armoires. Suis-je vraiment obligé de faire tout cela, et que se passe-t-il si je refuse ?

gold_facts.text: The realisation can be challenged only by a complaint against the award or against the private sale deed.
The complaint deadline runs from the time the complainant learned of the contested act and could know the grounds for the challenge.
The right of complaint lapses one year after the realisation.

competing_candidates: The general article on complaints to the supervisory authority and its ten-day deadline, which this article modifies for realisations.
The real estate realisation rules, which refer to this article.
provenance.critic_notes: DE: 'Das Beschwerderecht erlischt ein Jahr nach der Verwertung'; al.2 deadline from knowledge. All 3 facts supported. 281.1:17 general 10-day rule is modified by this article; not equal. DE rank 1045, no copying.

question: Mein gepfändetes Auto wurde vom Betreibungsamt versteigert. Erst drei Monate später habe ich erfahren, dass bei der Versteigerung Fehler gemacht wurden. Wie kann ich mich gegen den Verkauf noch wehren, ab wann läuft meine Frist, und gibt es eine Grenze, nach der gar nichts mehr geht?

gold_facts.text: During the extraordinary moratorium the debtor may continue his business.
He must not carry out legal acts that harm the legitimate interests of the creditors or favour some creditors to the detriment of others.

competing_candidates: The article on the effects of a composition moratorium on the debtor's powers, which is a different procedure from the extraordinary moratorium.
provenance.critic_notes: IT: 'Il debitore può continuare il suo commercio ... vietato ... favorire certi creditori'. Supported. Note 281.1:345 lets the court require commissioner consent for paying pre-moratorium debts; related, not equal. 281.1:298 is the composition-moratorium analogue. Easy is fine.

question: Per via di una crisi economica eccezionale che ha colpito tutto il settore, mi è stata concessa una sospensione straordinaria dei pagamenti. Nel frattempo posso continuare a lavorare normalmente con la mia ditta? C'è qualcosa che non posso fare, per esempio saldare per primo il debito verso un fornitore amico?

provenance.critic_notes: Searched Erbschaftssteuer/Steuer, impôt/fiscal, imposta in all acts de/fr/it: only incidental tax mentions (210:86a, 210:765). Closest: ZGB heirs rules (210:458). No reader could give a rate. Pointer citation not applicable.
provenance.writer_note: Likely wrong retrieval: Civil Code articles on statutory heirs and acquisition of the estate.

question: Meine Tante ist gestorben und hat mir als Neffe ihr Haus im Kanton Luzern vererbt. Muss ich darauf Erbschaftssteuer bezahlen, und wie hoch ist der Steuersatz für Neffen?
trap_reason: Inheritance tax is cantonal tax law; the Civil Code only governs who inherits, not how an inheritance is taxed.

provenance.critic_notes: 220:227a-227i and 228 repealed (footnote: 1.7.2014) in de/fr/it. Searched Vorauszahlung/paiement préalable/pagamento anticipato: only transitional 220:u2/3. Closest plausible: KKG withdrawal 221.214.1:16 (consumer credit, not prepayment). Not answerable; no pointer.
provenance.writer_note: Likely wrong retrieval: Consumer Credit Act articles on withdrawal, or general sale rules on payment and delivery.

question: J'ai signé un contrat pour acheter une cuisine que je paie d'avance par mensualités ; la livraison n'aura lieu qu'une fois tout payé. Le vendeur est-il obligé de placer mes versements sur un compte d'épargne bloqué à mon nom, et puis-je résilier ce contrat quand je veux ?
trap_reason: The Code of Obligations' special rules on prepayment purchase contracts were repealed with effect from 1 July 2014, so no in-force article regulates them.

provenance.critic_notes: Now asks for the ordinance figures. No current rate in the 8 acts (de/fr/it); only % mentions in 221.214.1 are 14, 18, 25. Closest 221.214.1:14 (15% guideline), a pointer, not an answer.
provenance.writer_note: Likely wrong retrieval: the Consumer Credit Act article on the maximum interest rate, which states only that the Federal Council fixes it and a general guideline ceiling.

question: Ho chiesto un piccolo prestito in contanti a una banca. Quale tasso d'interesse massimo ha fissato attualmente il Consiglio federale per i crediti in contanti, e quale per lo scoperto della carta di credito?
trap_reason: The Consumer Credit Act only empowers the Federal Council to fix the maximum rate; the rates currently in force for cash loans and card overdrafts are set in the implementing ordinance, not in the act.

provenance.critic_notes: Asks for case-law method and needs tables; no 'Tabelle'/method text in any act. Closest 210:285 (criteria only), a pointer; cannot answer the method or tables.
provenance.writer_note: Likely wrong retrieval: Civil Code article on the criteria for child maintenance (needs of the child, situation and means of the parents).

question: We are separating and our son is 10. Which calculation method has the Federal Supreme Court prescribed for child support, and which tables do courts use to put a figure on a 10-year-old's monthly needs?
trap_reason: The Civil Code only names the criteria for child support; the calculation method comes from Federal Supreme Court case law and the needs tables from cantonal or practice sources.

provenance.critic_notes: 210:349-358 and 210:359 repealed (footnote: 1.1.2000). Heimstätte/asile de famille/asilo di famiglia: 0 in-force hits. Closest: family property 210:335 ff., exempt assets 281.1:92. Not answerable; no pointer.
provenance.writer_note: Likely wrong retrieval: Debt Enforcement and Bankruptcy Act articles on assets exempt from seizure, or Civil Code articles on family property communities.

question: Mein Grossvater hat erzählt, man könne ein Wohnhaus oder einen Bauernhof als Familienheimstätte im Grundbuch eintragen lassen, damit es der Familie erhalten bleibt und nicht gepfändet werden kann. Wie richtet man heute eine solche Heimstätte ein?
trap_reason: The Civil Code provisions on family homesteads were repealed with effect from 1 January 2000, so no in-force article allows one to be created.

provenance.critic_notes: 220:929 al.2 (application, facts to be supported by documents) and 220:931 (duty to register) are closest; no list of documents. 'beglaubigten Unterschriften' only in 220:556/597 (general/limited partnerships), not sole proprietorships. Not answerable; pointer 220:929 reasonable.
provenance.writer_note: Likely wrong retrieval: Code of Obligations articles on the registration duty of sole proprietorships and on the commercial register.

question: Mon entreprise individuelle de peinture a dépassé le chiffre d'affaires à partir duquel il faut s'inscrire au registre du commerce. Quels documents dois-je joindre à la demande d'inscription, et dois-je faire légaliser ma signature ?
trap_reason: The Code of Obligations sets the duty to register a sole proprietorship, but the documents and signature formalities are laid down in the Commercial Register Ordinance.

provenance.critic_notes: 210:954 'dürfen die Kantone Gebühren erheben' (de/fr/it) is the closest; no amounts for notary or land register fees anywhere. Not answerable; pointer 210:954 reasonable.
provenance.writer_note: Likely wrong retrieval: Code of Obligations article on the form of land sale contracts, or Civil Code articles on land register entries.

question: Sto comprando un appartamento a Lugano per 600'000 franchi. Quanto mi costerà l'onorario del notaio per l'atto di compravendita, e quanto la tassa per l'iscrizione nel registro fondiario?
